source.title: Kanji List Grade 1-5
source.program: PPS Dual Language Immersion Japanese Program
source.note: Transcribed from a 9-page scan. The scan has no text layer; every row was read from 300dpi page renders. Row identity (no / kanji / grade) was transcribed twice independently and the two passes agree on all 242 rows.

fields.no: The sheet's own No column. 1-242, gapless, one per kanji, no duplicates. Stable content-derived key - NOT teaching order and NOT MEXT order; the sheet is sorted by grade and the numbers jump.
fields.grade: PPS grade the kanji is assigned to: 1-5, or "ch" for the sixth tier printed past grade 5.
fields.write: true if the sheet shades the kanji cell. The header reads: students must READ all assigned kanji, and WRITE the shaded ones. Read off page renders - re-verify before relying on it per-row.
fields.readings: From the 読み方 column, in sheet order. Okurigana and partial-word context stay in the full-width parentheses the sheet uses. Optional g = the grade tag the sheet prints on that reading.
fields.usage: From the 使い方 column, in sheet order. w = the word as printed, INCLUDING the sheet's kana substitutions (でん車, 全ぶ, ず工) - these are deliberate and must not be 'corrected'. Optional g = the grade tag the sheet prints after that word, i.e. the grade the word itself is introduced. Optional r = a reading the sheet disambiguates in-line.
